evidence.field: 形義通解; 字形; 銘文用例, lines 172–178
evidence.text: The page reports an analysis of oracle-bone 外 as 卜, interpreting crack orientation as distinguishing inside from outside; it says bronze forms add 月 as a phonetic marker and later forms use 夕. It also notes 月 and 夕 were once represented by the same graph. This is the database’s analysis, not independent resolution of the earliest graph’s interpretation.
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫: 外

evidence.text: The entry gives 外 as Middle Chinese ngwajH and Baxter–Sagart Old Chinese *[ŋ]ʷˁa[t]-s; it separately lists Zhengzhang’s *ŋʷaːds. This confirms a genuine system-specific difference with the latter secondary transcription, which should not be merged into the Baxter–Sagart notation.
evidence.kind: secondary reconstruction compilation and notation comparison
evidence.title: 外 - Wiktionary

evidence.field: Exact local rows for 月 and 外; columns py, MC, OC, gloss
evidence.text: The supplied Baxter–Sagart 2014 rows are 月: py yuè, MC ngjwot, OC *[ŋ]ʷat, gloss “moon, month”; 外: py wài, MC ngwajH, OC *[ŋ]ʷˤa[t]-s, gloss “outside.” These similar but nonidentical same-system forms make the reported phonetic role plausible as a comparison, but do not prove the role or a full sound-change path. Local row provenance is sources/baxter-sagart/baxtersagart.tsv; the cited CUHK page reports the analysis but does not host the table rows.

The earliest graph’s interpretation remains disputed. CUHK reports the crack-orientation explanation and 月 phonetic analysis, but the evidence inspected does not independently settle the earliest formation or prove a complete sound-change path.

items.tradition: Oracle-bone script style; modern vector redraw
items.caption: A modern redraw of 外 in an oracle-bone script style. One interpretation reads an early form as 卜 and takes the crack’s orientation to mark “outside”; this explanation remains disputed.
items.alt: A black angular glyph on a white background, with a tall curved stroke on the left and a long diagonal stroke rising to the right.
items.selection_reason: The file page explicitly identifies this as 外 in oracle-bone script style, and its stated CC0 terms allow reuse. The supported label is a script style, not an independently verified artifact date.
items.rights: The Commons page states CC0 1.0 and public-domain dedication for the image.

limitations.text: This is a modern redraw, not an ancient artifact image. Commons labels its style Shang oracle script, but does not identify the depicted design as a specific dated Shang witness; the early graph’s interpretation remains disputed.
